data.title: Strategy's Phong Le Defends Buying Bitcoin At $80K After Selling Near $60K: ‘Right Trade’
data.description: Strategy’s (MSTR) decision to sell Bitcoin (BTC) in the 60,000 range, only to resume buying near $80,000, may look like a costly case of selling low and buying high, but to CEO Phong Le it was the ‘right trade” to make at the time.When asked about the sell-low, buy-high sequence during an interview…
